name: Compress PDF
description: Shrink file size while keeping the document readable.
seoTitle: Compress a PDF — reduce file size free | PDFChill
seoDescription: Reduce the size of a PDF with a quality level you choose. Free, no uploads — compression runs in your browser.

low.name: Low
low.hint: Barely noticeable. Best for keeping print quality.

medium.name: Medium
medium.hint: Recommended. Good balance of size and quality.

high.name: High
high.hint: Smallest file. Use when you need to hit a size limit.

progress.cannotCancel: This can take a moment and cannot be cancelled.

result.noChange: Already as small as it gets

detail.noCanvas: Your browser cannot re-encode images, so only lossless structural optimisation ran. The file is still valid — try a newer browser for bigger savings.
detail.alreadyOptimal: This PDF was already optimised, so the original file was kept.
detail.imagesAlreadyEfficient: The images in this PDF were already efficient, so only lossless structural optimisation applied.
